entities.name: Péter Kovács
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Péter Kovács is a Hungarian professor of international law at the Peter Pazmany Catholic University, where he is the head of the Public International Law Department and the Doctoral School. Kovács was a judge at the Constitutional Court of Hungary from 2005 to 2014. Previously he served as a diplomat at the Embassy of Hungary in Paris and as the head of the Department for Human Rights and Minority Protection in the Hungarian Ministry of Foreign Affairs. Kovács was elected as a judge on the International Criminal Court (ICC) in the 2014 election of judges by the Assembly of State Parties.

entities.summary: Péter Kovács is a Hungarian professor of international law at the Peter Pazmany Catholic University, where he is the head of the Public International Law Department and the Doctoral School. Kovács was a judge at the Constitutional Court of Hungary from 2005 to 2014. Previously he served as a diplomat at the Embassy of Hungary in Paris and as the head of the Department for Human Rights and Minority Protection in the Hungarian Ministry of Foreign Affairs. Kovács was elected as a judge on the International Criminal Court (ICC) in the 2014 election of judges by the Assembly of State Parties.
